Video wallpapers play without sound, in a loop, cropped to the screen. Free without a key: Wikimedia Commons (free licenses) and NASA (public domain). Pexels and Pixabay work with your own key (stored only on this device). A direct link or your own file also works. The maximum is 1080p (720p on weak devices); up to 3 videos are kept in the cache. Playback pauses when the screen is off or another app is on top. Off by default.
Video loads the processor and memory. On weak set-top boxes it is better to keep it off.
This device has little memory (1 GB or less): video may slow it down and close other apps. Not recommended.
The video could not be played on this device: a still frame is shown
The file is too big (more than 120 MB)
